name: Kuchi

shortTermThrottle.scope: Approximate, per Cloudflare location. Shared by the MCP server and the /agent routes. Shared proxy IPs share the allowance.

accessPolicy.websiteAndVideoPlayback: Public and outside the agent-service throttle.
accessPolicy.agentService: Open: the MCP server and the /agent manifest, catalog and workflow routes need no account or token.
accessPolicy.publicBootstrap: SKILL.md and connection links are public.

updatePolicy.refresh: The server re-reads the published catalog at most once a minute. New videos appear without reinstalling.
updatePolicy.clientBootstrap: Keep the existing MCP endpoint and installed skill.
updatePolicy.breakingChanges: Changed tool names or endpoint URLs may need a client to refresh its tool list.

description: Real product-launch videos to use as inspiration templates. Kuchi supplies structure; the user supplies their own product, assets and copy.
